data.one_liner: AWS Pinpoint analytics plugin for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a way to send analytics events to AWS Pinpoint from a Flutter app. It supports Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux, and works with the Amplify Flutter ecosystem.
use_when: You need analytics integration with AWS Pinpoint
Your app targets multiple platforms including web and desktop
You already use Amplify Flutter for other services
avoid_when: You are using a different analytics provider such as Firebase Analytics or Mixpanel
You only need simple event logging without a backend
strengths: Official AWS plugin with full platform support
Works seamlessly with Amplify Flutter core
weaknesses: Does not support DataStore or Notifications categories
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec, run flutter pub get, configure Amplify in main.dart, and call Amplify.addPlugin(AmplifyAnalyticsPinpoint()).
